tb21_profile.skill: Implement a correct dominant-eigenpair solver for small (<=10x10) real non-symmetric matrices and make it beat numpy's own eig on median wall-clock
tb21_profile.domain: NumPy/SciPy/LAPACK dense numerical linear algebra plus Python-level micro-optimisation (C extension, numba, direct LAPACK calls)
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec against a hard performance budget (optimise-for-a-budget), with an accuracy predicate

Matrix function on small dense matrices, must beat scipy reference in /app/eval.py. Identical optimise-a-numpy-primitive genre.
Fix a wrong structured-matrix determinant and beat np.linalg.det; exploiting matrix structure for speed is the same lever.
Must be consistently faster than np.convolve with identical results; teaches algorithmic replacement of a numpy primitive under a timing budget.
